name: Client Android emulator

modes.what: Planned: Chausar will prepare what to paste there. For now, Visit site opens it.
Planned until owner SDK setup and a named lawyer permission review. Test the client build manually meanwhile.

note: Exact client APK operations on a clean emulator only. Owner setup and a named lawyer permission review are required; test manually meanwhile.

steps: 1. Install Android SDK platform tools and build tools yourself, then start a clean emulator without personal accounts.
2. Choose the client order, select its original APK and approve the exact test plan. Client operations wait for a named lawyer permission review.
3. Read the current emulator screen and approve each operation separately. Review every finding and remove the exact installed client app when finished.
guide.skipped: Use client-owned builds and fictional data. Real phones, personal accounts and arbitrary shell commands are refused.
guide.checks: Nothing connects to it in this build, so there is no access to check.
guide.sends: Sends: only exact approved commands to the local emulator after setup and permission review. No app-store upload.
guide.agentLimits: Agents cannot install SDK tools, replace an existing app, bypass a sign-in or send the client report.

name: Private demo desktop

modes.what: Planned: Chausar will prepare what to paste there. For now, Visit site opens it.
Planned until owner image qualification and a named lawyer permission review. Prepare the demo script meanwhile.

auth: Owner-installed Docker and qualified local image
note: Only the supplied throwaway desktop image with fictional client test data. Build and qualify it yourself; prepare scripts meanwhile. No automatic pull or installation.

steps: 1. Install Docker yourself and build the supplied Chausar demo image manually. Qualify its installed fingerprint before client use.
2. Prepare and approve the script, shot list and fictional client test account. Open only the separate private viewer and sign in yourself.
3. Approve recording and every input separately. Render, watch and listen to the entire video, then remove the owned desktop.
guide.skipped: Never record the owner desktop or enter personal account credentials. An unknown result needs manual inspection, never an automatic retry.
guide.checks: Nothing connects to it in this build, so there is no access to check.
guide.sends: Sends: only exact approved local Docker operations. Any website traffic stays inside the fictional client test session.
guide.agentLimits: Agents cannot pull or build images, mount owner files, control the owner desktop or approve their own recordings.

name: Reviewed app report and demo files

modes.what: Exports actual source-bound reports and owner-reviewed demo files after named permission review. The owner delivers manually.

note: Exports actual source-bound reports or videos after named permission review. The owner delivers them manually.

steps: 1. Review all actual findings and their reproduced steps, or watch and listen to the exact rendered demo and every planned shot.
2. After named lawyer permission review, prepare the source-bound report or video downloads in the testing desk.
3. Open the actual files, check their disclosure and limitations, then deliver them yourself.
guide.skipped: A clean log does not prove the whole app is correct. Missing audio word timings remain unmeasured.
guide.checks: Chausar rechecks the current client, source bytes, approvals and rendered file fingerprints before export.
guide.sends: Sends: nothing to the client. You download and deliver the reviewed files manually.
guide.agentLimits: Agents cannot invent a tested device, completed step, generated audio, delivered file or client acceptance.
